mentions.name: Clazel
mentions.description: A formally verified web browser written in Rust, built as an experiment in using AI during development. It currently works as a Lynx-style text browser with sandboxed rendering, HTML parsing, and link navigation, with the goal of pushing the formal verification approach further.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on Clazel, an experiment in using AI to make a formally verified web browser in Rust.

So far it’s a Lynx-style text browser with sandboxed rendering, HTML parsing and link navigation, but I want to see how far I can take it
mentions.author: atiernanberry
